cluster_summary: This cluster contains vulnerabilities where deserialization or configuration loading fails to enforce security-critical flags or validate external data, leading to arbitrary code execution or attribute injection. The common coding mistake is assuming that input data is safe without proper sanitization, allowlists, or propagation of user security settings.
guideline_text: Trace untrusted serialized bytes, object streams, pickles, marshaled payloads, or type metadata into deserializers that instantiate classes, reconstruct object graphs, or invoke callbacks during object creation. Report code paths where allowed classes, object types, and construction side effects are not constrained before deserialization. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should use type allowlists, safe codecs, signature checks, or data-only formats instead of general object deserialization.

mechanism.missing_guard: allowed classes, object types, and construction side effects are not constrained before deserialization
mechanism.name: untrusted deserialization with attacker-controlled type graph
mechanism.sink_shape: deserializers that instantiate classes, reconstruct object graphs, or invoke callbacks during object creation
mechanism.source_shape: untrusted serialized bytes, object streams, pickles, marshaled payloads, or type metadata
mechanism.typical_fix: use type allowlists, safe codecs, signature checks, or data-only formats instead of general object deserialization

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add an explicit safety check that validates or forces the safe deserialization flag before proceeding with the load operation.
sub_patterns.name: Missing safe-mode check in deserialization
sub_patterns.root_cause: Code fails to enforce safe deserialization flags (safe_mode, weights_only) when loading external data, allowing arbitrary code execution via pickle or SavedModel loading.
